name: Substrate Communion Robe
description:
A flowing, semi-organic robe worn by adherents of the Substrate Communion — a quasi-religious movement that views living substrate technology as evidence of a higher biological intelligence. The robe is grown from a benign substrate culture and maintained through periodic nutrient soaking. It is technically alive, responding to the wearer's body temperature with subtle shifts in texture and color.

Wearing a Communion Robe is a declaration of faith in biological technology as sacred. The robes are uncomfortable — the living fabric occasionally moves against the skin in ways that require acclimatization. True believers consider the discomfort part of the communion experience.
functionality: Religious identity, community membership, living-technology demonstration
what_it_says: You believe living technology is divine, and you've wrapped yourself in your faith.
story_hooks: A Substrate Communion Robe begins exhibiting behavior its wearers have never seen — the living fabric is growing new structures, and the Communion's leadership can't decide if it's evolution or revelation.
